title: Why does only ONE key open your door? 🔑 #shorts
description: How a pin-tumbler lock works: spring-loaded pin stacks block the plug until the right key lifts every gap to the shear line. Linus Yale Jr. perfected the pin-tumbler cylinder lock by 1865, and the basic design is still used in most homes today. Sources: Wikipedia (Pin tumbler lock, Linus Yale Jr.), CBS News Almanac.
